renderings.value: The blunt command form, used in orders, signs, and rough speech.
The imperative is direct and forceful, so it is largely limited to commands, slogans, quoted orders, and emphatic rough speech. Recognising it matters more than producing it.
Godan shift to the え-row (書く -> 書け, 飲む -> 飲め); ichidan drop る + ろ (食べる -> 食べろ); する -> しろ, 来る -> 来い.
